parameters.query:
-- `previous` ve la foto anterior al UPDATE: RETURNING devolvería los
-- valores nuevos (ya NULL) y se perdería el file id que hay que borrar.
WITH previous AS (
    SELECT signature_drive_file_id
    FROM public.users
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
), cleared AS (
    UPDATE public.users
    SET signature_filename      = NULL,
        signature_mimetype      = NULL,
        signature_drive_file_id = NULL,
        signature_web_view_link = NULL,
        signature_updated_at    = NOW()
    WHERE id = $1::uuid
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT cleared.id::text          AS id,
       previous.signature_drive_file_id AS previous_drive_file_id
FROM cleared
CROSS JOIN previous;

CONFIGURACIÓN REQUERIDA:
1. Credencial 'Postgres' (POSTGRES_CREDENTIAL_ID).
2. Credencial 'Google Drive' (GOOGLE_DRIVE_CREDENTIAL_ID).
3. Webhook CON autenticación Bearer.
4. Verificar el permiso: USER_SIGNATURE_UPLOAD (firma propia) o
   USER_SIGNATURE_MANAGE (firma de otro usuario).

RUTA: DELETE https://<tu-n8n>/webhook/users/signature/delete

REQUEST: { "user_id": "<uuid>" }
RESPONSE 200: { "success": true, "user_id": "..." }

Las recetas ya emitidas NO se ven afectadas en su contenido: guardan su
content_html. La firma sí deja de renderizarse al reimprimirlas, porque la
imagen se resuelve en vivo contra GET /users/signature.

REQUISITOS: database/scripts/068_20260819_prescriptions-and-doctor-signature.sql
CONTRATO:   src/constants/routes.ts → USER_SIGNATURE_DELETE
